luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local me = console.getBlock()
check(me.getInfo().getName():find("Computer") ~= nil, "computer info")
check(peripheral.getCurrentBlock().getId() == me.getId(), "current block")

check(me.setCustomData(json.encode({mode = "test"})) ~= false, "setCustomData")
check(json.decode(me.getCustomData()).mode == "test", "getCustomData")
me.setCustomData("{}")

local entity = me.getEntity()
check(entity.getName() ~= nil, "entity name")
check(entity.getBlockAt(p).getId() == me.getId(), "entity.getBlockAt")

local disp = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "display")
check(disp ~= nil, "wrap display")
disp.setText("world test")
check(disp.getText() == "world test", "display text")
check(peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "vault") == nil, "wrong wrap type is nil")
print("PASS block_and_display")
